context: Ren tells Hiroshi-boss about a startup plan.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business chat; vocabulary (起業/オフィス/応募/枠/配置) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いつか、起業したいと思っています。
lines.en: Someday I want to start a business.
lines.style: earnest young manager voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 立派な志だ。オフィスは考えたかね?
lines.en: An admirable ambition. Thought about an office?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 小さなオフィスを、探しています。
lines.en: I'm looking for a small office.
lines.style: engaged young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 人は、どう集めるつもりかね?
lines.en: How do you plan to gather people?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 応募を募って、数人の枠を埋めます。
lines.en: I'll take applications and fill a few slots.
lines.style: measured young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 働きやすい配置を、考えます。
lines.en: I'll think of an arrangement that's easy to work in.
lines.style: confident young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 起業の夢、応援しているよ。
lines.en: I support your dream to start a business.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm decisive closing throughout
